confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors are cross-checked against several 2026 cost-of-living aggregators (Numbeo-derived snapshots and similar guides) that broadly agree. Cocktail and wine anchors rest on fewer and more scattered sources, with one high outlier, so they are bounded estimates. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge for Rome's July peak season, not from live listings or search. Euro-denominated source prices were converted to USD at a rate consistent with the RBA's same-day EUR and USD quotes. The FX observation was taken from search summaries of the RBA exchange-rate pages, not from an opened RBA table. Food prices are 2026 snapshots rather than July-specific figures.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Restaurant, coffee, beer and drink anchors come from Rome-specific aggregator data. Accommodation tiers reflect typical Rome summer hotel and hostel pricing as a model estimate.
